title: goal_questions drops a numbered question's own words before its colon as a lead-in, so researched packs only the list after it
goal: goal_questions keeps a numbered question's own words before its colon when that text is itself the question (it starts with a question word), so researched packs the whole question

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_land as b
q=b.goal_questions('(1) What should a message hold? (4) What token cost does coordination add: agent teams, subagent briefs and the summaries they return?')
print(q);sys.exit(0 if any(x.startswith('What token cost') for x in q) else 1)
